description: Serie Storica Verbali Codice della strada iscritti a ruolo esattoriale is a dataset listed in Italian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Regione Puglia. Il dataset contiene n. 7 files relativi alle somme iscritte a ruolo esattoriale per i verbali, non oblati, elevati a seguito di infrazioni del Codice della strada. Coverage: Regione Puglia. The portal files it under the publisher Regione Puglia. Its tags are ausiliari-del-traffico, cartella-esattoriale, infrazioni, polizia-locale, verbali. It offers 8 resource(s) in CSV, XLSX. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-it-portal.
